caption_L2L3: From 2000 unemployment was 0.010 and has slowly crept up until a peak in 2008 when it rapidly increased from 0.013 and peaking at 0.019 in 2012.  It has come down slightly around 2016 to 0.017 increasing slightly in 2017.
